name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the generated continuation aligns with the given context and fact, ensuring it remains on-topic and relevant throughout.

name: Coherence
description: Assesses the logical consistency and flow of the generated continuation, ensuring it forms a coherent and understandable conversation.

name: Fluency
description: Evaluates the grammatical correctness and linguistic smoothness of the generated continuation, ensuring it reads like a naturally written text.

name: Engagement
description: Measures the ability of the generated continuation to attract and maintain the reader's interest, making it enjoyable and captivating.

name: Creativity
description: Assesses the originality and imaginative aspects of the generated continuation, ensuring it goes beyond simple fact recitation.
